purpose: One contributed programming tail improves automatically selected answers while retaining the unmodified general path.
selection: One terminal checkpoint only. Development must gain at least two coding tasks, preserve every general response, and meet latency bounds before final opens. No tuning or retries on final.
scope: Operated research. Old public MBPP with official task splits; pretraining contamination unknown. General retention is exact response preservation, not independently graded correctness. No quality promotion, NEURO issuance, permissionless verification or replacement of the accepted alpha graph.
